people.name: Jehoiakim
people.line: King of Judah, son of Josiah

people.name: Nebuchadnezzar
people.line: Emperor of Babylon who conquered Judah

translations.web: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his servant three years. Then he turned and rebelled against him.
translations.bsb: During Jehoiakim’s reign, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon invaded. So Jehoiakim became his vassal for three years, until he turned and rebelled against Nebuchadnezzar.
translations.kjv: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his servant three years: then he turned and rebelled against him.
